name: Data Cleaner
description: Clean and validate table data with Skill-only workflows.
longDescription: Data Cleaner is a Skill-only plugin. It adds local instructions for profiling columns, normalizing values, detecting duplicates, and producing data-quality summaries without declaring any MCP server.

skills.name: data-cleaner
skills.description: Inspect, clean, normalize, deduplicate, or validate tabular data before import or analysis.

starterPrompts: Review this CSV and suggest cleanup rules.
Find likely duplicate rows in this table.
